items.summary: Implement real backend computation for `getInsightsData()` so Insights no longer returns placeholder/zero values and correctly reflects the couple’s post-deploy ritual activity.
Fix streak and completion calculations to be order-stable and couple-based, counting a day as complete only when both partners have submitted a ritual response for that day.

Compute and return harmony metrics from real stored data: quiz alignment (from both partners’ saved Love Languages quiz results) + recent ritual consistency (from recent completion trends), and expose them via `quizOverlapScore`, `recentCompletionRate`, `currentHarmony`, and `averageHarmony`.
Replace `getBadgeMilestones()` default milestone logic with real computed milestone progress (7/30/100 day streaks and harmony elite) derived from the same computations used by `getInsightsData()`.

Ensure ritual submission writes/maintains the canonical daily history used by Insights so that a successful “both completed today” state is reflected consistently across Home, Ritual History, and Insights.
Add lightweight diagnostic logging around ritual submission and daily completion resolution to aid debugging without breaking queries or leaking sensitive content.

Update frontend data expectations only where needed to display the newly-real backend Insights values (no UI redesign), ensuring the Insights screen updates after ritual submission without requiring a hard reload.
